positions.name: ReviewerEnrollmentProbe
positions.frame: what is the relationship between this probe memory and the e2e suite's assertion that saving a memory enrolls its creator as a reviewer?
positions.why: src-1 declares what the e2e suite asserts — that saving a memory enrolls its creator as a reviewer — and src-2 explains that this probe memory exists solely to carry that assertion. Together they cohere under the read of how a probe artifact relates to the test-suite claim it is designed to surface.
